title: fix: restore owner name in PR target branch selector

target.summary: `#pull-target-branch` is queried within `pullDescEditor`, but it is not a descendant of `#pull-desc-editor`. Selecting a branch from the branch-select dropdown evaluates `pullTargetBranch` to null, throwing a TypeError when accessing its attributes and breaking target branch selection.
notes: faulty querySelector for #pull-target-branch within pullDescEditor where it is not a descendant
